description.value:
The red mage gains a reservoir of mystical arcane energy equal to half his red mage level (minimum 1) + his Charisma modifier, refreshing once per day after a full 8-hour rest.

As a swift action, he can expend 1 point to grant any weapon he is holding a +1 enhancement bonus for 1 minute, gaining another +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd (maximum +5 at 18th level), stacking with existing enhancement to a max of +5. At 6th level, these bonuses can instead add weapon special properties (earthen, flaming, frost, jetstream, keen, roaring, shock; their burst versions; speed; dancing; vorpal), consuming bonus equal to the property's base price modifier. A red mage can only enhance one weapon at a time; using this ability again ends the first use. These bonuses do not function if wielded by anyone other than the red mage.
